identity.material: canonical UTF-8 JSON core; sort object keys; compact separators; preserve array order; no non-finite numbers

laws.evidence_applicability: complete exact provenance equality AND independent owner verdict admission; this law never establishes Test PASS or Debug witness admission
laws.root_identity: ordered declared root bindings and content identity; paths alone are not identity
laws.abi: actual compiled backend schema/interface + successful declared executor ABI admission, bound to executor bytes
laws.build_assurance: owner build receipt records observed compilation, not source-to-binary compiler self-attestation or verification PASS
laws.subject: native decision receipts bind the closed argument subject only; Test/Debug/Actions must add their exact domain subject/obligation/failure/request and owner applicability; native decision receipt equality never equates two source failures

source_revision: optional observation metadata; exact actual source bytes and compiler/executor bytes are required; a prebuilt compiler without an owner build receipt retains unknown source origin
